id: title:Gilbert09:classify portal migration as a retryable error

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion recovery for HubSpot connector
review.reason: Adds transient error handling and test assertions for HubSpot portal migration status, allowing ingestion workflows to recover rather than fail permanently.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies solely on supplied hunk IDs; no broader implementation or test execution results are available to verify actual recovery behavior or complete change scope.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are available; no other hunks, file context, or surrounding implementation are provided, so broader change assessment and tier assignment are not possible.

observations.behavior: Adds 'Migration in progress' to the set of retryable errors in HubSpot source, and adds its message to the test assertion for transient HTTP errors.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the HubSpot warehouse ingestion workflow to treat the HubSpot portal migration status as a transient, recoverable condition rather than a permanent failure, supporting recovery once the migration completes.

observations.behavior: Updates the test assertion to include the HubSpot migration message alongside the rate-limit message, while retaining the rate-limit message in the assertion.
observations.code_quote: "Migration in progress and the portal is not available for access.",
observations.posthog_connection: Updates warehouse ingestion tests to recognize the HubSpot migration status message as a transient, recoverable condition alongside the rate-limit message.
